text.description_html:
Extra Thick Door Arched Keypad Deadbolt

The Thick Door Keypad Deadbolt provides convenience for today's active lifestyles. A Keypad Entry Door Lock means there are no keys to forget, lose, or worry about whom has a copy. Plus, no more hiding keys under rocks or in the mailbox. With the thick door Keypad, it is easy to make sure only the people whom you want to have access to your home do. Simplify your life with the latest in front door lock security. The Keypad Entry Door Lock is for use on extra thick doors between 1-7/8 inches up to 2-1/2 inches. The distinctive solid brass design combines architectural inspired arches with graceful curves for a traditional look.

The Keypad Deadbolt is an ANSI grade 2 single cylinder deadbolt. It has a 19 user code capacity and features a six digit programing mechanical key override for adding and deleting users codes.

Single Cylinder Deadbolt: is operated by either a key or an access code from the outside and by a thumbturn on the inside.

Also available: Other style Thick Door Locks.

Features of the DBE365/02007 Thick Door Keypad Deadbolt:

  • Innovative Turn Lock feature allows you to lock your door and leave without a key.
  • Provides the convenience of keyless access.
  • Easily replaces most existing deadbolts with a screwdriver in about 30 minutes.
  • No programming required; preset with two user codes so it's ready to use right out of the box.
  • Grade 2 ANSI/BHMA certified.
  • Patented commercial grade clutching motor drive; tested to one million cycles.
  • Vandal resistant free-spinning deadbolt turn.
  • Warning sounds after four incorrect codes entered; keypad disabled for 30 seconds.
  • Mechanical key override.
  • Blue LEDs illuminate the keypad on demand.
  • Locks can be re-keyed to match existing locks.
  • Uses a standard 9-volt battery.
  • Easily programmed right at the keypad so there is no need to remove inside escutcheon.
  • Holds up to 19 user codes with 10,000 possible user code combinations.
  • A pre-set 6-digit programming code is required to add and delete user codes.
  • Keypad Entry Lock Specifications (PDF)

Specifications of the DBE365/02007 Thick Door Keypad Deadbolt:

  • Height: 6-2/5"
  • Width: 3-1/2"
  • Projection: 4-1/2"
  • Adjustable from 1-7/8" to 2-1/2" door thicknesses.
  • Universal latches fits either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets.

Note: For use with 1-7/8" to 2-1/2" Thick Doors.
